client.value: Atlântico Seguros, a mid-size Portuguese insurer
client.quote: Atlântico Seguros, a mid-size Portuguese insurer

problem_statement.value: Atlântico Seguros wants to understand why property and health claims take too long to settle and what claims operating model it should move to. Motor claims were improved in 2024; property and health were not.
problem_statement.quote: why property and health claims take too long to settle and what claims operating model it should move to

engagement_type.quote: they want a diagnostic and a recommendation, not implementation support

engagement_length.assumption_text: Not given; the Phase Architect estimates the duration.

stakeholders.quote: the COO and the Head of Claims, and the final answer goes to the Board

deliverable_format.value: A written report and a board presentation
deliverable_format.quote: a written report and a board presentation

timeline.value: Recommendations presented to the Board on March 15, 2027

prior_attempts.value: An internal lean program in 2024 cut handling time for motor claims only
prior_attempts.quote: an internal lean program in 2024 that cut handling time for motor claims only

success_criteria.value: Reduce average settlement time for property and health claims; keep customer satisfaction at least at current levels
success_criteria.quote: reduce average settlement time without customer satisfaction dropping

out_of_scope.quote: replacing the claims IT system is out of scope
